title: Social reactions
body: Choose a reaction by its searchable name. Targeted reactions require an eligible member. Roast privacy is checked before publication and again for the one-use Roast Back. Notmad is server-owner only. Haiku is an exact joke, not a profiling tool.

fields.action: Search all38 approved reactions; aliases like touch grass and type shit are supported.
fields.member: Choose the target member when required by the selected reaction.

steps: Open /social react and search for the reaction.
Select an eligible member when the reaction needs a target.
Review before submitting: reactions appear publicly in the configured main chat.
For roasts, the target may Roast Back once while the control is available. Privacy and confinement still apply.
Use /privacy roast to control whether you may be targeted.
